name: Founder decision: Ratify the one path by which a diagnostic read reaches a person, and the refusal to write about a person
text_content:
P41 and P42. Tension slack is the only mode whose read can reach a person, and the path is ordered on records: the line names the seat and the adjacent seats carrying its load; the domain fix is made and read back; the person's own check-in line is the only person-side source; after the recurrence threshold the diagnostic may write one statement, that the seat remains occupied and its load carried by named adjacent seats after the domain's fix, with dates; it then hands to Session 12, and only through it to Session 14, and never to Session 15. The diagnostic writes nothing about any person anywhere: no name on any evidence line, scorecard section, house memo, reset record, or leads' review mark, and nothing on the person page, which it reads for the building's friction and the person's path only. This is what keeps "No Disposable People" (Canon 1.0, section 01) a property of the instrument and keeps Session 13's four dimensions closed against a fifth. Blocks row 115 and Sessions 12 and 14's inheritance. High.

Filed by Session 9 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmj07. Reasoning lives on the S9 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
